_about: Longer LK5 Pro on Klipper, stock MK8-style Bowden hotend (PTFE to the nozzle), PLA. One config per material, all speed tiers. Tuned on a 0.3 mm nozzle; other nozzle sizes untested.
_flow_points_note: One curve for every speed tier (temperature follows flow, not tier). 210 C at ~5 mm3/s, the peak flow of Fast/Extra Fast caps; an Extra Fast cap at 205 peak showed slight under-extrusion (2026-11-08). Most of a print sits ~198-200 C. Previous curve 1->195, 5->205, 10->215 is in git history.
_rates_note: From klippy.log: full-power heating ~0.7 C/s and heater-off cooling ~0.35 C/s near 190-210 C. While printing the heater already runs ~74% (peaks 98%), so usable extra heating is much lower.
